english.title: Go with / without a vehicle / vessel onto / into a restricted zone of a harbour area
english.standardoffencewording: On **(..SPECIFY DATE..) at **(..SPECIFY TOWNSHIP..), without lawful authority or reasonable excuse, went onto or into a part of a restricted zone of harbour area at **(..SPECIFY LOCATION..), other than with the permission of the competent authority or a person acting on behalf of that authority and in accordance with the conditions subject to which that permission was for the time being granted
english.legislation: Contrary to section 39(1)(a) and (3) of the Aviation and Maritime Security Act 1990.
english.pointstoprove:

english.standardstatementoffacts: On **(..SPECIFY DATE..) at **(..SPECIFY TOWNSHIP..) the defendant, without lawful authority or reasonable excuse, went onto or into a part of a restricted zone of a harbour area at **(..SPECIFY LOCATION..), other than with the permission of the competent authority or a person acting on behalf of that authority and in accordance with the conditions subject to which that permission was for the time being granted.

other.penalty:
Summary: A fine not exceeding level five on the standard scale

Time Limit for Prosecutions:
6 months

On the 12th March 2015 the limit on fines imposed by a Magistrates' court was removed – as such, the potential fine on summary conviction in relation to an offence committed after this date is unlimited.
